visual.general_description: Two side-by-side wide-field color fundus photographs, one labeled R and one labeled L on screen, with a blue arrow on the left image.
visual.detailed_description: Two color fundus photographs sit side by side on a black background, separated by a thin white vertical line, with on-image text overlays in each corner. Image on the left: wide-field orange-yellow retina with the optic disc right of center, retinal vessels radiating from it, and a small round reddish-brown spot to its left. A blue arrow starts at the lower left and points toward the pale yellowish area around that spot. Dark eyelash shadows cross the lower right and right edge; a white crescent lies at the upper left edge. Text overlay on the left image: "RGB OptomapPlus", "Image: 1", two lines of "4000", "OPTOS, P200DTx", "Laterality: R", "Red: 33%", "Green: 33%", "Blue: 33%", "NEWER", "Zoom: 1.50", "Tint: 100%", "Presentation: Multiple". Several header fields in the upper left and one in the upper right are covered by orange bars; remnants of text are not legible. Image on the right: smaller circular fundus view with a brownish-orange retina, optic disc left of center and a small darker spot to its right, framed by dark teal eyelid skin at the top and eyelid and eyelashes at the bottom. A short bright horizontal streak lies above and left of the disc. Text overlay on the right image: "RGB OptomapPlus", "Image: 4", two lines of "4000", "OPTOS, P200DTx", "Laterality: L", "Red: 33%", "Green: 33%", "Blue: 33%", "NEWER", "Zoom: 1.50", "Tint: 100%", "Presentation: Multiple", with similar orange bars over the upper header fields. No panel letters are printed. Only one arrow is present, on the left image.

visual.general_description: Frontal volume-rendered CT angiogram of the head and neck vessels with a white arrow at the lower left.
visual.detailed_description: Frontal three-dimensional volume-rendered CT angiogram on a black background in a golden-brown color map, showing the aortic arch at the bottom, vessels rising through the neck and an intracranial vascular network at the top. Two long vessels rise from the arch region toward the head. On the image-right side they are thick, smooth and tortuous. On the image-left side the corresponding vessels are thin and irregular, with a separate short looped fragment near the skull base. A white arrow in the lower left of the image points at an irregular, lumpy, nodular-looking structure around a narrow vessel just above a thick vessel arising near the arch. A thick vessel extends horizontally to each side at the bottom, with the left-in-image one ending in small irregular branches. Viewer overlay text is partly cropped: "No cut" and "No Filter" in yellow at the upper left, a cropped word starting with "Ex" at the upper right, short text at the lower left and a short yellow label at the bottom center. No panel letters, scale bars, side markers or axes are printed.
